note: Twenty-four pages, 51 measured regions: 24 page-foot watermark banners (the p24 one fused with a text column), 18 exhibit regions and 9 non-exhibit or second-panel regions. The exhibits are 13 figures - Figures 1 to 13 with no gaps - and 5 tables, the last four numbered Table 2 to Table 5 because the paper's numbering starts at 2, plus one uncaptioned, unnumbered notation table on p5. Figure 2 on p7 carries two stacked panels, Figure 7 on p13 two side-by-side panels and Figure 12 on p21 four panels, each counted once. Figure 2 is never cited; the closing page is a letter with a decorative word cloud and no exhibit.
rules: Every figure caption in this paper prints below its art and every table caption prints above its grid - [caption.position] is 'below' for all 13 items and 'above' for all 5 tables, matching the printed y of the caption line against the region top.

Figures 2, 7 and 12 are one caption over several measured boxes: 2 stacked panels on p7, 2 side-by-side panels on p13 and 4 panels on p21. Each is recorded once on its first panel with [geometry.panel_count] and [geometry.panel_layout] set, and the other panels are excluded as 'duplicate' rather than double counted.

The notation table on p5 carries no caption and no number at all; [caption.numbering] is 'none', caption_source is 'none', and the mention block records 0 because the paper never cites it by number - Table 1 does not exist and table numbering starts at Table 2.

Figure 2 is the only numbered exhibit never cited anywhere in the body; its row carries [mention.count] 0 rather than a guess at a nearby sentence, and the stray printed fragments 'Fig. 2.' on p6 and 'Table 5.' on p21 are caption fragments, not citations.
The ligatures ﬁ and ﬂ are used for 'fi' and 'fl' in the text layer, so the heading quoted in [place.section_path] and every sentence quoted under [mention.style] keep the ligature exactly as printed.

Table 4 is cited from section 4.4 but printed above the top of p20, after the '4.5 Dynamic Process of Evolution' heading at the foot of p19; [place.section_path] records 4.5 because the section assignment follows printed order, and the row note says the citing section is 4.4.

Three of the five tables carry booktabs rules only and Table 4 adds one vertical rule between its side-by-side blocks, so [table.rule_style] is 'booktabs' four times and 'vertical-rules' once; no table in this paper is boxed or zebra-striped.

Figure 6 is a schematic drawing rather than a plot, so [geometry.family] is 'flowchart-or-schematic'; Figure 11 is a circular scatter cloud with three point classes and no axes, recorded as [geometry.family] 'scatter'.

Figures 5, 7, 8, 9 and 13 are histogram or density-curve plots and are recorded as 'histogram' once (Fig. 5, filled patches) and 'line' four times; the [geometry.family] counts are checked against the printed art and not against the caption wording.

The 24 page-foot watermark banners, one per page, hold one measured region each except p24, where the measurer fused the banner with the right-hand text column; [place.page_zone] and [geometry.colorbar] are read from the measured box and never from the watermark.

tables.note: Uncaptioned, unnumbered notation table under the heading '3.2 Notations'.
